name: mdx-message-offline-queue-contract
human_line: Every send goes through the outbox, online or not - one path, so exactly-once is a property of the design. Words written offline wait visibly and go out the moment the kernel is back.

idempotency.kernel_behavior: the governed write records message_id and the projection echoes it per message
idempotency.retry_safety: before resending any attempted item, the client probes the projection for its message_id - a hit means saved, the entry retires without a duplicate

queue.fallback: memory-only when IndexedDB is unavailable (private mode) - sends still work, persistence is best-effort and never pretended
queue.crash_recovery: items found in sending state at load return to queued; the probe decides whether the earlier attempt landed

flush.order: oldest first, serial, one flush at a time
flush.jitter: 0.75x to 1.25x, so a thousand reconnecting clients never stampede
duplicate_suppression: projection probe by message_id before any resend
timeline render filters pending items whose message_id the kernel already echoed
live envelopes dedupe against both receipt_id and message_id
flush.policy_refusals: a REFUSED answer is terminal - the item retires without retry and the person is told why

surface.pending_entries: render in place with honest state - sending, or will-send-when-back
surface.pending_bar: N waiting to send, with a send-now affordance
surface.offline_banner: offline state named plainly, with last-synced time
surface.failed_affordance: not sent yet - tap to retry
surface.composer: never blocks on the network - the queue absorbs the wait

proof: kill the network, send, restore the network: the kernel records the message exactly once and the queue drains to zero
